|''[[Clue scroll (beginner) - Blow a raspberry at Aris in her tent|Blow a raspberry at Aris in her tent.]]''
''Equip a [[gold ring]] and a [[gold necklace]].''
|{{plinkp|Gold ring}} {{plinkp|Gold necklace}}
|[[Aris]] can be found in her tent at [[Varrock Square]].

|''[[Clue scroll (beginner) - Bow to Brugsen Bursen at the Grand Exchange|Bow to Brugsen Bursen at the Grand Exchange.]]''
|
|[[Brugsen Bursen]] is found inside the [[Grand Exchange]].
|[[File:Emote clue - bow Brugsen Bursen.png|150px]]

|''[[Clue scroll (beginner) - Cheer at Iffie Nitter|Cheer at Iffie Nitter.]]''
''Equip a [[chef's hat]] and a [[red cape]].''
|{{plinkp|Chef's hat}} {{plinkp|Red cape}}
|[[Iffie]] can be found in [[Thessalia's Fine Clothes]] store in [[Varrock]].
|[[File:Emote clue - cheer iffie nitter.png|150px]]

|''[[Clue scroll (beginner) - Clap at Bob's Brilliant Axes|Clap at Bob's Brilliant Axes.]]''
''Equip a [[bronze axe]] and [[leather boots]].''
|{{plinkp|Bronze axe}} {{plinkp|Leather boots}}
|[[Bob's Brilliant Axes]] is located in south [[Lumbridge]], right outside [[Lumbridge Castle]].
|[[File:Emote clue - clap bobs brilliant axes.png|150px]]

|''[[Clue scroll (beginner) - Panic at Al Kharid mine|Panic at Al Kharid mine.]]''
|
|[[Al Kharid mine]] is located just north of [[Al Kharid]]. The area is quite large, so the step can also be completed at the southern entrance of the mine or standing in the north-western corner outside the mine.
|[[File:Emote clue - panic al kharid mine.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (beginner) - Spin at Flynn's Mace Shop|Spin at Flynn's Mace Shop.]]''
|
|[[Flynn's Mace Market]] is located near the north entrance of [[Falador]].
|[[File:Emote clue - spin mace market.png|150px]]
